item.description: - Apps with a minimum width, like Music and TV, no longer slide over their neighbors on smaller screens. - The tour now teaches Overview and showing the desktop, and only takes your gestures while its window is in front. - When macOS uses the same trackpad gestures, Butterfly tells you exactly which switches to turn off. - License checks recover as soon as your Mac is back online, with clearer messages about moving a license to another Mac. - Updating from the old Chain app no longer asks for an administrator password.

- Going full screen, for example with a video, no longer moves your windows on the strip or makes them slide back when you return. - Apps that show a small loading window at launch, like Slack, now take their normal place on the strip.

- Report a problem now addresses the email to hello@butterflyformac.com. - Activating a license no longer sends your computer's name. - Clearer wording about what Butterfly checks online. - Diagnostic links no longer work in release builds.
